quote: Here, we identify Cpl1 as an effector protein secreted by C. neoformans that drives alternative activation (M2 polarization) of macrophages to enable murine pulmonary infection.
notes: Cpl1 is a small secreted cysteine-rich protein paralogous to the Cfl1 adhesin but characterized as a secreted immunity effector (no adhesion role). PMID 32805526 (strain JEC21): CPL1 deletion increased adhesive and invasive growth, so Cpl1 negatively regulates adhesion rather than mediating it. N1 (characterized non-adhesive function).

quote: Studies by Mosbach et al. (2011) showed that hydrophobins are neither involved in conferring surface hydrophobicity to conidia and aerial hyphae of B. cinerea, nor are they required for virulence.
notes: Hydrophobin family (mechanism 2c) shown NOT to confer conidial/aerial surface hydrophobicity or to be required for attachment/virulence in B. cinerea; only developmental (sclerotium/apothecium) roles. N1 (characterized non-adhesive role).

quote: hydrophobins are neither involved in conferring surface hydrophobicity to conidia and aerial hyphae of B. cinerea, nor are they required for virulence.
notes: As Bhp1: hydrophobin family shown non-hydrophobic/non-virulence in B. cinerea; developmental roles only.

quote: Sclerotia of double knock out mutant dBhp1/dBhp3 and the triple knock out mutant, however, showed easily wettable phenotypes.
notes: As Bhp1: hydrophobin family shown non-adhesive/developmental in B. cinerea; no host-surface adhesion evidence.

quote: One spore hydrophobin, HfbA, shared 72.56% sequence identity to the Aspergillus fumigatus spore hydrophobin RodA and was required for efficient spore dispersion in P. expansum.
notes: Hydrophobin (mechanism 2c family) in P. expansum required for spore dispersal/colonization, not cell-substrate adhesion; no protein-level adhesion to a host surface demonstrated. N1 (characterized non-adhesive role).

quote: However, HSP60 did not exhibit similar inhibition on conidia adherence.
notes: HSP60 was co-identified in the extracellular proteome and tested in parallel with GAPDH; recombinant HSP60 and anti-HSP60 serum did NOT inhibit conidial adhesion to fibronectin/laminin/pneumocytes. A surface-exported moonlighting candidate demonstrated non-adhesive. N1.

quote: We describe here a shared surface and cell wall protein, endoglucanase 2 (Eng2)... exposure to Eng2 vaccinated and protected... mice against lethal experimental infections by eliciting adaptive immunity.
notes: Conserved surface/cell-wall endoglucanase; a protective immunodominant antigen, no adhesion/host-binding function demonstrated. N2 (adhesin-like surface-walled enzyme, no adhesion evidence).

quote: MoMsb2 is required for appressorium formation... the results suggest that MoMsb2 functions as a cell surface sensor.
notes: Transmembrane mucin-like cell-surface sensor upstream of the Pmk1 MAPK pathway (sensing hydrophobicity/cutin to trigger appressorium formation). Adhesin-like architecture (mucin/Ser-Thr-rich surface protein); function is signal sensing, not adhesion. N2 (no adhesion/binding evidence; non-adhesive role).

quote: Lip1... releases alkanes and primary fatty alcohols from the host epicuticular wax... providing a source of fatty acids for the pathogen.
notes: Secreted lipase localized to the fungal cell-wall surface; it degrades host epicuticular wax to generate cues for appressorium formation. Adhesin-like (secreted wall-associated); function is wax degradation, not adhesion. N2.

quote: The inability to extend surface hyphae resulted in a complete loss of virulence on plants.
notes: Predicted type 2 glycosyltransferase required for fungal hyphal extension on solid surfaces; mutant cannot extend surface hyphae and loses plant virulence. GPI/wall-associated enzyme look-alike; function is surface hyphal growth, not adhesion. N2.
